$comment: Phrases known to come from a copyleft or proprietary source, stored as SHA-256 prefixes of normalised 8-word windows rather than as text. The point of the encoding is not obscurity - it is that a list built to stop us copying somebody's words should not itself be a copy of them. Add an entry with scripts/licence/add-verbatim-phrase.py, which prints the hash and never writes the phrase.
algorithm: sha256 of the lowercased, punctuation-stripped, single-spaced 8-word window, first 16 hex characters
